dialogue.name: Teo
dialogue.text: Teo. Drummer. Currently providing only the first half of the service.

dialogue.name: Teo
dialogue.text: The wind rolled my drum off a camel on our last night crossing. It went *south, under the old ribcage*, past your crash site. Too dark to fetch it then.

dialogue.name: Teo
dialogue.text: The wind rolled my drum off a camel on our last night crossing. It went *south, under the old ribcage*, past your crash site. Too dark to fetch it then.

dialogue.name: Teo
dialogue.text: You’ll look? Red drum, shells around the rim. South, under the great ribcage, beyond your ship. Ignore any sand pretending to be part of it.

sub.text: Is it on? Right. There you are. We haven’t heard from you for so long.
And I’m still disappointed in you. The boat, the school. You leave everything half done.
Main power drained. Emergency reserve only.
Not enough to hold orbit. Taking us down.
Emergency power online. Whatever passed us drained the core and left a magnetic signature on the hull. I can track its pulse.
Emergency power online. Whatever passed us drained the core and left a magnetic signature on the hull. I can track its pulse.
Then track it. When we can fly, we follow it. I want to hear it again.

hud.cue: Plumb: Best bet? The village on the horizon.

sub.text: Overhead, the singing light. It comes down out of the dusk, slowly, the way none of them ever saw it do.)
The singing light’s signature, here too. Strongest among the humming standing stones.
The singing light’s signature, here too. Strongest among the humming standing stones.
The same pulse, faint, on people below who saw the light pass. I'll mark them on your map.
Course set: The Desert. Hold on.
